strings.name: Strive Masiyiwa
strings.summary: Born in Zimbabwe, Masiyiwa grew up in Zambia and studied in Britain, returning to start businesses after an electrical engineering degree. He founded Econet and launched its mobile network in 1998 after government licensing refusal and prolonged litigation, later expanding into fiber, cloud and data centers. With his wife, he supports education and helped coordinate African medical supplies and vaccine procurement during the pandemic.
